errors.evidence: The description states there are five regions, but the chart displays and the text itself lists six regions (Северозападен, Северен, Североизточен, Югоизточен, Югозападен и Южен).
The smallest total railway network length (gray bar) is in the Northeastern region ("Североизточен") with 484 km, not in the Southern region ("Южен") with 782 km.

errors.text_span: най-дългите двойни линии са в Северозападния регион (192 км)
errors.evidence: The longest double lines (blue bar) are in the Northeastern region ("Североизточен") with 244 km, not in the Northwestern region ("Северозападен") with 192 km.
This part of the sentence refers to the shortest double lines. The shortest double lines (blue bar) are in the Northern region ("Северен") with 89 km, not in the Southern region ("Южен") with 116 km.

This part of the sentence refers to the shortest electrified lines. The shortest electrified line (orange bar) is 369 km in the Northeastern region ("Североизточен"). The description incorrectly states the value is 89 km in the Northern region; 89 km corresponds to the double lines in that region, not the electrified lines.
